{{Top|leg}}
'''Lab Module A''' was one of the [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]] modules of the [[Maw Installation]]. It served as the primary research lab for the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star project]], before being given over to the [[Metal-Crystal Phase Shifter]] team.
